facts.fact: The ministry's page presents Loi 2019-03 of 30 April 2019 on electronic transactions in Niger as governing electronic transactions, covering electronic signatures, contracts and payments, data retention and sanctions; it does not state an entry-into-force date or any repeal.
facts.system: Loi 2019-03 du 30 avril 2019 portant sur les transactions électroniques

note: No fact on reach: the page names no rules made under the law and no application.
